description: We’re a team building a software-only entry for Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data. Our tool uses NASA POWER climate data to help farmers compare crop rotations based on their soil, water and priorities. We’re looking for [roles, e.g. a front-end developer, someone with agriculture or earth-science knowledge, a designer for the pitch video]. We have [your skills]. Message us with your skills and availability for the 14–15 November event.
